messages:
Anita P.: Quick async check — retention milestone for console observability is next Thu. Can each owner drop a one-line status + blockers? :calendar:

Tom H.: Tracing hooks PR is merged to staging, but I still need a small follow-up to wire span attributes for model_id. CC @Leah G. for dashboard mapping. Should be done by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Leah G.: Dashboards: core error-analysis view is drafted. Waiting on Tom's model_id attribute to link traces <> errors. Also need approval on the UX tweak I posted in #design. No infra blockers from our side.

Ravi S.: Retention infra: object lifecycle policy for trace blobs is provisioned, but we discovered a cost spike when TTL < 7d due to small-file overhead. Storage team wants us to batch uploads or increase chunk size. Can we accept 7d min or do we need 3d? :thinking_face:

Anita P.: Product prefers 3d for compliance reasons in EMEA. Is batching a viable short-term workaround?

Ravi S.: Batching looks doable but requires a small change in the agent that uploads traces (adds a 60s buffer). I can ship a patch, but it needs a quick review from eng-runtime. ETA 2 days.

Tom H.: I can review the agent patch tomorrow morning. Need the PR link. Also, note that batching increases memory for the agent by ~8MB — flagged SRE. @Kim L.

Kim L.: SRE: 8MB is fine for our targets, but if we scale to million agents we should quantify. Also will need a canary rollout + monitor for upload failures (500s) — I'll add a tracing alert.

Leah G.: For the error-analysis view, can someone add a sample trace id (or a small fixture) so I can validate the join logic? I can fake it if needed but prefer real example.

Tom H.: Dropping a sample in the shared bucket: gs://redwood-dev/traces/2026-03-17/sample-0001.json (contains model_id: "rwd-tiny-v1"). Use that for the dashboard.

Ravi S.: Infra note: the lifecycle policy change requires a maintenance window because it touches the bucket ACLs for archival class. Proposed window: Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC. Any objections?

Anita P.: Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC works for Product. Leah/Tom/Kim — please ack here if that window is OK.

Leah G.: Ack.

Tom H.: Ack.

Kim L.: Ack. I'll add the canary and the alert runbook before the window.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: bucket-lifecycle-update -> 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z (owner: Ravi S.). CI pipeline: green.

Anita P.: Awesome — summary for next steps: (1) Ravi ship agent batching patch (2d) and run lifecycle change Wed 02:00 UTC, (2) Tom review agent + provide sample trace (done), (3) Leah finish dashboard join and UX review, (4) Kim prepare canary + alerting. If anything slips, call it out here. :party-popper:
